technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: SilicaproofX® 1 is a single side coated metal waterstop for sealing construction joints in reinforced concrete structures. SilicaproofX® 1 builds up its function once the coating gets in contact with humidity/water. In first instance the crystals integrally bond to the concrete. In second instance the coating below the crystals start to swell which will initiate a swell pressure to build up. The product is manufactured at Junghansring 52 in Rottenburg a. N. The slit strip is delivered to the production site and inserted into the sheet metal machine. The adhesive tape is clamped and glued to the inserted sheet, the granules and the overlap strip are applied. The metal waterstop is then packaged for transportation.

technologicalApplicability.value: All typical construction joints: suitable for all typical construction joints between base/base, base/wall, wall/wall, wall/ceiling, ceiling/ceiling.
